laws.rule: Parque Regional Municipal Astillero Municipal Volcán de Acatenango: no sound equipment, respect wildlife/plants and camp only in authorised places. The recommendations say to take a local guide. The hours field says only Acceso libre: this is not treated as free-of-charge admission, a 24-hour entitlement or authority to use closed/unsafe routes.

items.text: Acatenango municipal park: its official visitor entry says not to drink alcoholic beverages within the installations. This is the specific park condition, not a department-wide alcohol ban.
